sources.excerpt: By Stomp Under Foot Inspired by Trey Anastasio's early '90s rig, the Divided Drive captures the magic of stacking two Tube Screamers into a Ross Compressor. It combines two modified Screamer-style overdrives with a Ross-style compressor in a single pedal, recreating the tight, thick tone and endless sustain of that classic setup. The overdrives are based on the discontinued Serenity Overdrive, a stripped-down Tube Screamer variant with a fuller, warmer voice and exceptional clarity. The compressor is based on the original 1970s Ross Compressor and uses the same RCA CA3080E OTA found in those early units, a long-discontinued chip prized for its smooth, musical compression. Each section works independently or can be cascaded together, delivering everything from subtle grit to soaring sustain. Features: True-Bypass NOS Through-Hole Components 9V Adapter Only Handmade in the U.S.A. View details

sources.h1: Stomp Under Foot’s Divided Drive Pedal: A Tone Tailors Exclusive
sources.excerpt: Stomp Under Foot | December 4, 2025 posted by: Levi Introducing the Divided Drive: A Tone Tailors Exclusive Built for Players Who Chase Iconic Tone For guitarists who live for great overdrive, expressive sustain, and the unmistakable feel of a finely tuned signal chain, a new piece of gear has officially arrived—and it’s making a serious impact. The Stomp Under Foot Divided Drive , available exclusively through Tone Tailors, is a limited-edition pedal engineered for players who want the character of a vintage, stacked rig in a single, streamlined enclosure. Designed through a collaborative effort between Stomp Under Foot and our team at Tone Tailors , the Divided Drive blends boutique circuitry, hand-built craftsmanship, and legendary tonal inspiration into one of the most impressive releases of the year. With fewer than 20 units produced and only 14 remaining in stock, this is a rare opportunity to own a unique piece of gear you won’t find anywhere else. From Trey Anastasio fans to players looking for versatile overdrive and compression options, the Divided Drive stands out as both a musical tool and a collector’s item. Limited Stock, Buy Now A Collaboration Focused on Authentic Tone The Divided Drive was born from a simple but ambitious goal: recreate the lush, harmonically rich, stacked-overdrive tone associated with early 1990s Trey Anastasio—without requiring multiple pedals or complex routing. Bringing this concept to life required meticulous circuit design, careful component selection, and a deep understanding of how those legendary rigs behaved and responded. Stomp Under Foot, known for their dedication to accuracy and high-quality reproduction of classic effects, partnered with Tone Tailors to engineer a dual-overdrive and compressor system that feels like stepping directly into that era of iconic sound. This collaboration ensures that the pedal isn’t just inspired by a vintage setup—it authentically mirrors it. Two Modified Overdrives and One Vintage-voiced Compressor Modified Dual Overdrives The two overdrive circuits are based on Stomp Under Foot’s discontinued Serenity Overdrive, a minimalist Tube Screamer-style pedal that strips away excess controls in favor of pure tone. For the Divided Drive , both circuits feature proprietary modifications that significantly expand the tonal capabilities. Players can expect: A fuller and warmer frequency response Reduced mid-hump compared to traditional Tube Screamers Improved clarity and articulation A more open and dynamic feel, especially at medium and high gain These circuits deliver everything from subtle breakup to thick, saturated lead tones while maintaining note detail and avoiding the muddiness that often plagues stacked overdrive setups. Authentic Ross-Style Compressor The compressor circuit elevates this pedal into something truly unique. Modeled after the legendary 1970s Ross Compressor, this section uses the original, long-discontinued op-amp found in those vintage units. This rare component is essential to achieving the soft, musical compression and unmistakable sustain that made the Ross such an important part of countless rigs. Expect: Smooth, natural sustain A warm and rounded tonal decay Minimal noise Transparent yet expressive compression When placed after one or both overdrives, the compressor brings the entire signal to life, creating a singing, fluid tone that responds beautifully to dynamics. Designed for Versatility—not Just Replication While the Divided Drive was engineered to capture a specific tonal era, its range extends far beyond its inspiration. Because each circuit operates independently, players can shape everything from clean compression to low-gain blues tones to harmonically rich high-gain textures. Use cases include: Compressor only: ideal for clean rhythm work and shimmering open chords Single overdrive: perfect for classic rock, blues, worship, or indie grit Dual overdrive stack: thick, harmonically layered tones for leads or expressive solos Overdrives into the compressor: the signature configuration for endless sustain and articulation Whether you’re a jam-band fan, a studio musician, a worship player, or simply someone who wants multiple flavors of tone in one compact form, the Divided Drive adapts effortlessly. Premium Craftsmanship Built to Last As with all Stomp Under Foot pedals, the Divided Drive is hand-wired with high-quality components and rugged construction. This ensures long-term reliability whether you’re touring, recording, or practicing at home. The internal layout is clean and purpose-driven, reflecting the attention to detail that boutique pedal fans expect. Because this is an exclusive collaboration with Tone Tailors, the Divided Drive will not be mass-produced or reissued. Once this batch is gone, the pedal becomes a permanent piece of Tone Tailors’ history —and a rare find on the used market.
